apps.localizedDescription:
EffeTune Live is EffeTune for iOS.

Pick EffeTune as the output device and the sound from the app you are listening to runs through your effect chain before it reaches the speaker. iOS 27's Media Device Extension makes this work without a virtual cable or any system setup.

It works with apps that show up as Now Playing, the ones with a transport in Control Center. Apps that make sound without one, games among them, are not offered the route.

The DSP is the same one the desktop version uses, so chains and presets carry over. Share a chain as a link and open it on the web version, or the other way round.

Over 100 effects: EQ, dynamics, saturation, reverb, delay, modulation, spatial, restoration, and analyzers that draw what is actually happening to the signal.

EffeTune Live is not affiliated with the EffeTune project. Send anything about this app to nemut.ai, not to EffeTune.

privacy.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: EffeTune Live uses playAndRecord so it can send the processed sound back to the built-in speaker.
